evidenceActuallyInspected.title: Connect agents to Model Context Protocol servers
evidenceActuallyInspected.supportingSummary: The Toolbox versioning tip distinguishes a production consumer endpoint that serves the promoted default from a version-specific endpoint used to test a new version before promotion. It explicitly allows iteration on a new version without affecting production agents and requires the server label to remain unique per agent.
boundedSupportedFacts: The consumer endpoint has the shape {project_endpoint}/toolboxes/{name}/mcp?api-version=v1 and serves the promoted default version.
The version-specific endpoint has the shape {project_endpoint}/toolboxes/{name}/versions/{version}/mcp?api-version=v1 and is recommended for testing before promotion.
New-version iteration and production consumption are separated by the documented versioning pattern.
